semantically_equivalent_models.justification: Slot attention refers to a mechanism that utilizes attention in a way that is conceptually similar to the general idea of attention-based models. Both are built around the concept of using attention mechanisms to focus on specific parts of input data.

parent_models.justification: Attention-based models are a subset of neural network models since they implement neural network architectures with an attention mechanism.
Many attention-based models, such as LSTM-attention and recurrent attention models, are built on top of recurrent neural network architectures, thus making RNNs a parent category.
